reel_tumble._comment: $0F:A203, knockback index 18: thrown high and far, Freeza's Flaming Headbutt.

turn_round._comment: $0F:A499: he finds the opponent behind him and turns, 6 frames of his turning drawing.

collapse._comment: Fatigue spent (combat/fatigue.ts): the original's collapse, move 1d. Knockback 4 ($0D:D708) throws him up and away; he cannot be hit until he is up ($10:AF8E, field 0x96).

tired_up._comment: The get-up, 1f, with field f0 set by the collapse's end ($10:B031): it reads no buttons and goes on into 40 ($0F:A35E).

tired._comment: The original's tired pose, move 40, every fighter's: 300 frames ($0F:A366; pressing buttons counts three a frame there, not yet here). A blow ends it.

sent_off._comment: Sendoff (owner, 2026-11-26): thrown flat to the screen's edge in the pose of a body sent to another arena, but kept in this one; the wall throws him back, the floor downs him.

wall_bounce._comment: Off the wall a sendoff met, back toward whoever sent him and open to a blow on the way (owner, 2026-11-26): a little health and a thud, no burst yet, and far enough to be chased again (owner, 2026-11-27). Its body stands in the heavy reel's: the pose has none for some.

spiked._comment: Spike (owner, 2026-11-26): driven down into the floor, off it in `ground_bounce`. Its body stands in the heavy reel's: the pose has none for some.

ground_bounce._comment: Off the floor a spike drove him into: the floor costs him 20 (`hurts`), a thud and a shake; up again, open to a blow but to no vanish — a spike ends the chase (owner, 2026-11-26).

crumple._comment: Crumple (owner, 2026-11-26): the light reel's pose, pushed back and held for as long as the blow holds him — no pause on the blow, so he who struck goes on at once to a new combo; then he stands. Once a combo: given again, the knockdown.

crumple_pant._comment: A crumple held long (owner, 2026-11-27): past the reel's pose, 20 frames of stun or more left, he pants bent over (m40, the tired pose) until it runs out, on the same clock (keepsStun). Still reeling: the same rank, and a blow takes him as it takes the crumple.

lifted._comment: Lift (owner, 2026-11-26): taken up along with whoever struck him, flying as he does (`carries`), level with him; down flat on landing. Rank 1, the lowest a reaction has: a blow in the air takes him as any falling body, his juggle.
